# Purpose

This report compares national-level greenhouse-gas estimates from `FADN2Footprint` with the UNFCCC CRT 2026 inventory extract. The package run uses
its published mock FADN dataset; confidential farm-level data are not loaded or required.

The current direct comparison covers the top-level agriculture categories in Table 3 for enteric fermentation (3.A), manure management (3.B), and
agricultural soils (3.D), where the package and inventory both report total emissions in CO2 equivalents. Results are shown in kt CO2-eq. They are
descriptive comparisons, not an independent validation: the package run uses mock data and the FADN and inventory estimates may differ in coverage and
methodology.

# UNFCCC CRT 2026 data

The long CRT extract is produced from the 2026 submissions using the label-based cell mapping described in
[`extract_crt_2026.py`](../scripts/extract_crt_2026.py). It retains the country, inventory year, sheet, category label/code, variable label, numeric
value, notation flag, and unit checks. Source workbooks and extraction methodology are documented at the [UNFCCC inventory
portal](https://unfccc.int/reports?f%5B0%5D=document_type%3A4593&f%5B1%5D=year%3A2026).

```{r load_crt}

crt_data <- utils::read.csv(
    crt_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("", "NA"),
    check.names = FALSE
) |>
    # harmonized categories
    dplyr::mutate(
        UNFCCC_livcat = dplyr::case_when(
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("non\\s*-?\\s*dairy\\s*-?\\s*cattle", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "non_dairy_cattle",
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("dairy\\s*-?\\s*cattle", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "dairy_cattle",
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("cattle", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "cattle",
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("swine", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "swine",
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("poultry", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "poultry",
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("sheep", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "sheep",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        UNFCCC_crop = dplyr::case_when(
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("wheat", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "wheat",
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("barley", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "barley",
            stringr::str_detect(category, stringr::regex("maize", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "maize",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
    )

# crt_data |>
#  dplyr::filter(iso3 == "SWE", year == 2020) |>
#  dplyr::select(category, category_code, UNFCCC_livcat, UNFCCC_crop) |>
#  dplyr::distinct() |>
#  gt()

#crt_data |>
#    dplyr::filter(iso3 == "SWE", year == 2020) |>
#    reactable::reactable(searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)

```

Check notation keys: if IE (i.e., included somewhere else), emissions could be accounted for in another category
Script for analysis and parameter retrieval should flag "IE".

List of variables that is compared between the FADN2Footprint estimation and the UNFCCC reports:
 - Table3 SECTORAL REPORT FOR AGRICULTURE
    -   Total GHG emissions of enteric fermentation for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
   - Total GHG emissions of manure management for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
   - Total GHG emissions of agricultural soils for direct N2O emissions from managed soils, inorganic fertilizers, organic fertilizers and crop residues
   - Total GHG emissions of agricultural soils for indirect N2O emissions from managed soils
 - Table3.A Enteric Fermentation
   - Population size for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
   - Average gross energy intake (GE) for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
   - Emissions (CH4) for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
 - Table3.B(a) CH4 Emissions from Manure Management
   - Emissions (CH4) for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
 - Table3.B(b) N2O Emissions from Manure Management
   - Total N excreted for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
   - Direct Emissions (N2O) for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine
   - Total N volatilised as NH3, NOx and N2 for Indirect N2O emissions
   - Indirect Emissions (N2O) due to atmospheric deposition
   - Indirect Emissions (N2O) due to nitrogen leaching and runoff
 - Table3.D Direct and indirect N2O emissions from agricultural soils
   - Activity data value (t N) for Direct N2O emissions from managed soils
   - Activity data value (t N) for Inorganic N fertilizers
   - Activity data value (t N) for Organic N fertilizers
   - Activity data value (t N) for Animal manure applied to soils
   - Activity data value (t N) for Other organic fertilizers applied to soils
   - Activity data value (t N) for Urine and dung deposited by grazing animals
   - Activity data value (t N) for Crop residues
   - Activity data value (t N) for Indirect N2O Emissions from managed soils
   - Activity data value (t N) for Atmospheric deposition
   - Activity data value (t N) for Nitrogen leaching and run-off
   - Emissions of N2O due to Direct N2O emissions from managed soils
   - Emissions of N2O due to Inorganic N fertilizers
   - Emissions of N2O due to Organic N fertilizers
   - Emissions of N2O due to Animal manure applied to soils
   - Emissions of N2O due to Other organic fertilizers applied to soils
   - Emissions of N2O due to Urine and dung deposited by grazing animals
   - Emissions of N2O due to Crop residues
   - Emissions of N2O due to Indirect N2O Emissions from managed soils
   - Emissions of N2O due to Atmospheric deposition
   - Emissions of N2O due to Nitrogen leaching and run-off
 - Table3.F Field burning of agricultural residues
   - Crop production for wheat, barley and maize
 - Table4.B Cropland
   - Total cropland area
 - Table4.C Grassland
   - Total grassland area

The catalogue above records the detailed inventory variables under consideration. A detailed FADN-to-CRT match is only reported below when the package
output exposes an equivalent measure with a compatible unit and aggregation. Notation keys (for example `NO` and `NE`) are retained in the extract and
are never converted to numeric zero.

# Package output

Here, we use European FADN data for all member states, years 2018–2021, and run the `FADN2Footprint` package to estimate the greenhouse gas emissions.

```{r load_data, echo=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

## Load raw data and run model
# source("validation_FADN_data.R")
# source("validation_FADN_data_offline.R")
##
load(file.path(wd_path, "/data_raw/FADN_EU_17_21_obj_GHGE.RData"))
# my_object_GHGE <- m_prune_farms(my_object_GHGE,
#                                YEAR %in% c("2018", "2019", "2020"))

id_cols <- my_object_GHGE@traceability$id_cols

cat("FADN dataset loaded:", nrow(my_object_GHGE@farm), "farm-year observations\n")
cat("Countries covered:", paste(unique(my_object_GHGE@farm$COUNTRY), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Years covered:", paste(sort(unique(my_object_GHGE@farm$YEAR)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r farm_characteristics}

farm_charac <- my_object_GHGE@farm |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(id_cols, "SYS02"))) |>
    # add ISO country names
    dplyr::left_join(
        data_extra$country_names |>
            dplyr::transmute(
                COUNTRY = country_FADN,
                iso3 = Country_ISO_3166_1_A3
            ) |>
            dplyr::distinct(),
        by = "COUNTRY"
    )
```

# Comparison of F2F with UNFCCC data

## Crop areas and production

```{r area_unfccc}

# cropland area
crt_crop_area <- crt_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
        grepl("Total area", variable),
        grepl("Total cropland", category)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        YEAR = as.character(year)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat, value) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    # values are reported in kha
    dplyr::summarise(
        crop_area = sum(value * 1000, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR)
    )
# crt_crop_area  |> head() |> gt()

# grassland area
crt_grassland_area <- crt_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
        grepl("Total area", variable),
        grepl("Total grassland", category)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        YEAR = as.character(year)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat, value) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    # values are reported in kha
    dplyr::summarise(
        grassland_area = sum(value * 1000, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR)
    )
# crt_grassland_area  |> head() |> gt()

# join cropland and grassland area
crt_area <- dplyr::left_join(
    crt_crop_area,
    crt_grassland_area,
    by = c("iso3", "YEAR")
) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        total_area = crop_area + grassland_area
    )
```

```{r area_f2f_crop}

# Sum of individual crops
f2f_area_crop <- my_object_GHGE@crop |>
    # add farm characteristics
    dplyr::left_join(farm_charac,
        by = id_cols
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        total_area = sum(area_ha * SYS02, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR, land_use_type)
    )
# f2f_area_crop |> head() |> gt()

# With Total Crop Area variable SE025
f2f_area_tot <- my_object_GHGE@farm |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(id_cols), SE025) |>
    # add farm characteristics
    dplyr::left_join(farm_charac,
        by = id_cols
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        total_area = sum(SE025 * SYS02, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR)
    )
```

We distinguish grassland and cropland.

### Cropland

```{r comp_crop_area_unfccc_f2f_crop}

# Shared countries and years
shared_cat <- dplyr::intersect(
    f2f_area_crop |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR),
    crt_crop_area |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR)
)
# shared_cat |> gt()

# Compare value per livestock category and per year
# Filter to shared countries and years
comp_crop_area <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    f2f_area_crop  |> 
      dplyr::filter(land_use_type == "arable") |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(source = "f2f"),
    crt_crop_area |>
      dplyr::rename(total_area = crop_area) |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(source = "crt")
)
# comp_crop_area |> reactable::reactable(searchable = T, filterable = T)

## plot
p <- comp_crop_area |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        country_year = paste0(iso3, "_", YEAR)
    ) |>
    ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::aes(x = country_year, y = total_area, fill = source) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Comparison of Crop Area",
        x = "Country & Year",
        y = "Crop Area (ha)",
        fill = "Source"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
p
```

## Livestock population

```{r pop_size_UNFCCC}

# UNFCCC
crt_pop_size <- crt_data |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("Population size", variable)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        YEAR = as.character(year)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat, value) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        pop_size = sum(value * 1000, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
    )
# crt_pop_size  |> reactable::reactable(searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)
```

The retrieved UNFCCC data are comparable to FAO data (https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/QCL).

```{r pop_size_f2f_herd}
# F2F
f2f_pop_size <- my_object_GHGE@herd |>
    # add farm characteristics
    dplyr::left_join(farm_charac,
        by = id_cols
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        UNFCCC_livcat = dplyr::case_when(
            FADN_code_letter == "LCOWDAIR" ~ "dairy_cattle",
            species == "cattle" ~ "non_dairy_cattle",
            .default = species
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        # pop_size = sum(Qobs * livestock_unit_coef * SYS02, na.rm = TRUE),
        pop_size = sum(Qobs * SYS02, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
    )
# f2f_pop_size |> head() |> gt()
```


```{r comp_pop_size_unfccc_f2f_herd}

# Shared countries and years
shared_cat <- dplyr::intersect(
    f2f_pop_size |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat),
    crt_pop_size |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
)
# shared_cat |> gt()

# Compare value per livestock category and per year

# table of comparison
comp_pop_sum_crt_f2f <- crt_pop_size |>
  dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
    dplyr::rename(pop_size_crt = pop_size) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    f2f_pop_size |>
      dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
    dplyr::rename(pop_size_f2f = pop_size),
    by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rel_diff = (pop_size_crt - pop_size_f2f) / pop_size_crt
  )
# comp_pop_sum_crt_f2f |> reactable::reactable(searchable = T, filterable = T)


# scatterplot comparison of livestock population between CRT and F2F output
comp_pop_sum_crt_f2f |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = pop_size_crt, y = pop_size_f2f) +
  #ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(aes(color = iso3, fill = factor(YEAR)),
                      shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 2) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("palettesForR::Tango") +
  paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_d("khroma::smoothrainbow") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Comparison of Livestock Population between CRT and F2F output",
    x = "Livestock Population from CRT",
    y = "Livestock Population from F2F output",
    color = "Country",
    fill = "Year"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~UNFCCC_livcat, scales = "free") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

# plot heatmap of relative difference in livestock population
comp_pop_sum_crt_f2f |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(aes(x = YEAR, y = iso3, fill = rel_diff)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~UNFCCC_livcat, nrow = 2) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Country",
    fill = "Relative Difference"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = -0.1)
  )

```

As the FADN does not capture all the livestock population, we calculate a ratio to rescale livestock activity and emissions based on the comparison of population sizes between the F2F and UNFCCC data.

```{r pop_ratio}

pop_ratio <- crt_pop_size |>
    dplyr::left_join(f2f_pop_size, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat"), suffix = c("_crt", "_f2f")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        ratio = pop_size_crt / pop_size_f2f
    )
# pop_ratio |> head() |> gt()
```

## National activity data

List of activity variables that is compared between the FADN2Footprint estimation and the UNFCCC reports: 
- Table3.A Enteric Fermentation 
   - Population size for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine 
   - Average gross energy intake (GE) for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine 
- Table3.B(b) N2O Emissions from Manure Management 
   - Total N excreted for cattle, dairy cattle (LCOWDAIR in FADN), non dairy cattle, swine 
- Table3.D Direct and indirect N2O emissions from agricultural soils 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Direct N2O emissions from managed soils 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Inorganic N fertilizers 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Organic N fertilizers 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Animal manure applied to soils 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Other organic fertilizers applied to soils 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Urine and dung deposited by grazing animals 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Crop residues 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Indirect N2O Emissions from managed soils 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Atmospheric deposition 
   - Activity data value (t N) for Nitrogen leaching and run-off 
- Table3.F Field burning of agricultural residues 
   - Crop production for wheat, barley and maize 
- Table4.B Cropland 
   - Total cropland area 
- Table4.C Grassland 
   - Total grassland area

### Average gross energy intake

```{r avrg_GE}
# Average gross energy intake (GE) (MJ/head/day)

# UNFCCC
crt_avrg_GE <- crt_data |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("gross energy", variable)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        YEAR = as.character(year)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat, value) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        avrg_GE = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
    )
# crt_avrg_GE  |> view()

# F2F
f2f_avrg_GE <- my_object_GHGE@practices$herding$feed$feed_intake$total |>
    # add farm characteristics
    dplyr::left_join(farm_charac,
        by = id_cols
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        UNFCCC_livcat = dplyr::case_when(
            FADN_code_letter == "LCOWDAIR" ~ "dairy_cattle",
            species == "cattle" ~ "non_dairy_cattle",
            .default = species
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        avrg_GE = weighted.mean(GE_MJ_anim / 365, w = SYS02, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
    )
# f2f_avrg_GE |> head() |> gt()

# Shared countries and years
shared_cat <- dplyr::intersect(
    f2f_avrg_GE |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat),
    crt_avrg_GE |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
)
# shared_cat |> reactable::reactable(searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)

# Compare value per livestock category and per year
# Filter to shared countries and years
comp_avrg_GE <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    f2f_avrg_GE |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(source = "f2f"),
    crt_avrg_GE |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(source = "crt")
)
# comp_avrg_GE |> reactable::reactable(searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)

## plot
p <- comp_avrg_GE |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        country_year = paste0(iso3, "_", YEAR)
    ) |>
    ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::aes(x = country_year, y = avrg_GE, fill = source) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~UNFCCC_livcat, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Comparison of Average Gross Energy Intake",
        x = "Country & Year",
        y = "Average GE (MJ/head/day)"
    )
p
```   

### Nitrogen excretion and fertilizers

```{r tot_N_excr}
# Total N excreted (kg N/yr)

# UNFCCC
crt_tot_N_excr <- crt_data |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("Total N excreted", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        YEAR = as.character(year)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat, value) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        tot_N_excr = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
    )
# crt_tot_N_excr  |> dplyr::filter(iso3 == "FRA", YEAR == "2016") |> gt()

# F2F
f2f_tot_N_excr <- my_object_GHGE@practices$herding$N_excretion |>
    lapply(function(x) {
        x |>
            # add farm characteristics
            dplyr::left_join(farm_charac,
                by = id_cols
            ) |>
            dplyr::mutate(
                UNFCCC_livcat = dplyr::case_when(
                    FADN_code_letter == "LCOWDAIR" ~ "dairy_cattle",
                    species == "cattle" ~ "non_dairy_cattle",
                    .default = species
                )
            ) |>
            dplyr::summarise(
                tot_N_excr = sum(Nex_kgN_livcat_y * SYS02, na.rm = TRUE),
                .by = c(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
            )
    }) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows()
# f2f_tot_N_excr |> head() |> gt()

# Shared countries and years
shared_cat <- dplyr::intersect(
    f2f_tot_N_excr |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat),
    crt_tot_N_excr |> dplyr::select(iso3, YEAR, UNFCCC_livcat)
)
# shared_cat |> gt()

# Compare value per livestock category and per year
# Filter to shared countries and years
comp_tot_N_excr <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    f2f_tot_N_excr |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(source = "f2f"),
    crt_tot_N_excr |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(source = "crt")
)
# comp_tot_N_excr |> reactable::reactable(searchable = T, filterable = T)

## plot
p <- comp_tot_N_excr |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        country_year = paste0(iso3, "_", YEAR)
    ) |>
    ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::aes(x = country_year, y = tot_N_excr, fill = source) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~UNFCCC_livcat, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Comparison of Total N excreted",
        x = "Country & Year",
        y = "Total N excreted (kg N/yr)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
p
```

```{r tot_N_excr_rescaled}

# Apply population ratio to F2F extimation
f2f_tot_N_excr_rescaled <- f2f_tot_N_excr |>
    dplyr::left_join(pop_ratio, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        tot_N_excr = tot_N_excr * ratio
    )

# Compare value per livestock category and per year
# Filter to shared countries and years

    f2f_tot_N_excr_rescaled |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(source = "f2f"),
    crt_tot_N_excr |>
        dplyr::semi_join(shared_cat, by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "UNFCCC_livcat")) |>

)
```
